title: Settings
offlineNotice: Configuration stays in your account and will sync after you register a device.

backendsNoDevice.title: Register a device first
backendsNoDevice.body: An Agent backend runs on one of your machines. Register a desktop app or an agentred in this account, then come back and point a backend at it.

errors.noOnlineAgentred: No online compute node is available. Start or reconnect one of your devices and try again.
errors.builtinUnsupported: Built-in backends cannot be created in the browser console.
errors.unsupportedBackend: This backend type is not available in the browser console.
errors.deviceRequired: Pick the device this backend runs on before saving.
errors.deviceOffline: That device is offline right now, so nothing could be probed on it.
errors.deviceUnknown: That device is no longer in this account. Pick another one.

credential.HERMES_LOGIN_REQUIRED: This Hermes server requires signing in; enter a username and password.
credential.HERMES_LOGIN_EXPIRED: Your Hermes session expired; please sign in again.
credential.HERMES_RATE_LIMITED: Too many sign-in attempts; please try again later.
credential.HERMES_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED: This provider requires browser authorization, which is not supported yet.
credential.HERMES_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The identity provider is temporarily unavailable; try again later.
credential.HERMES_PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND: The server does not know this auth provider.
credential.HERMES_UNREACHABLE: Cannot reach the Hermes server; check the URL and network.
credential.unknown: That action failed on the bound device. Please try again.

activity.title: Activity stats
activity.body: Each of your machines reports one conversation count per day. The overview heatmap and the three distribution cards run on it.
activity.statusOff: Off · stats cover only conversations saved to your account
activity.loadError: Could not load your stats settings. Please try again.
activity.saveError: Could not save that. Please try again.

danger.title: Turn off activity stats
danger.body: Stop reporting, and delete the daily counts already on the server.

enable.title: Turn on activity stats
enable.body: Your desktop app and agentred start reporting one conversation count per day.
enable.reportDate: The date, and how many conversations you started that day
enable.reportDimensions: The Agent, backend and model it ran on
enable.backfill: Also backfill the history already on each machine
enable.backfillHint: Offline machines catch up on their own once they come back online.
enable.foot: You can turn it off in settings at any time; turning it off also deletes the counts already reported.

disable.title: Turn off activity stats?
disable.body: Every machine stops reporting, and the daily counts already on the server are deleted. The heatmap falls back to covering only saved conversations.
disable.note: Your saved conversations themselves are not affected.

saved.title: Saved conversations
saved.body: Only conversations you explicitly saved are stored in your account. This is not a switch — unsave them one at a time on the Conversations page.
